guidance: The only next node is an Elite. Current HP is 45/80; Burning Blood heals after a win, Booming Conch provides extra opening draw/energy, and all three potion slots are full. Play for a fast safe kill; preserving enough HP for the Act 1 boss matters more than hoarding potions. At each fresh combat state first calculate a certain lethal from live card damage, target block, multi-hit and retaliation. If no kill, prioritize attacks that suppress the most incoming damage, then block. Use Battle Trance+ before Pommel Strike when both are planned, because Battle Trance disables later draws this turn. Prefer Bash before follow-up attacks when Vulnerable adds enough damage. Perfected Strike is the main burst; use its current displayed value, not a fixed memorized number. Feel No Pain gives little without repeated exhaust; True Grit exhausts a random card, so count only guaranteed block. In a multi-turn elite, consider Strength Potion early; use Duplicator on a high-impact next card to save HP or secure a kill. Distilled Chaos has unknown draws: use it if the fight is slipping away, not for a trivial win. A potion that prevents roughly 6+ HP loss is worth spending with full slots. If enemy mechanics are unfamiliar or the computed end turn is lethal, trust fresh game data and the controller safety stop. After victory claim ordinary rewards; for cards prefer reliable boss damage, block, draw/energy or real exhaust synergy, and skip weak additions.
